description: Flexed posture of newborn (legs and arms together)
Watches face of person speaking to them
Fixates gaze on people or objects
When lying on stomach, lifts head
Begins to differentiate day and night
When lying on stomach, sustains head supported on forearm
Rolls from supine to prone position
Helps to sit up when held by hands
Transfers objects from one hand to another
Responds differently to familiar people and strangers
Says one word with meaning (e.g., mama)
